raw:
```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS single_card_monthly_rulings
FROM main.rulings r
JOIN main.cards c ON r.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.name = 'Kytheon, Hero of Akros // Gideon, Battle-Forged'
  AND c.setCode = 'ORI'
  AND r.date >= '2015-06-01'
  AND r.date < '2015-07-01'
```
